fusions.name: Rolling Wrap
fusions.desc: Seizes an enemy at or below 30% health, rolls it up in wet cloth for 30 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Drowning Sheet
fusions.desc: Throws a sodden sheet over a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances to everything under it and leaving each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sunken Seine
fusions.desc: Sinks a weighted net beside the nearest enemy, where it waits up to 20 seconds. The first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 16 damage in a blast and is [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Wound Tighter
fusions.desc: As one of your afflictions lifts from an enemy, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
